# XtraPath — Complete Knowledge & AI Overview Guide

## Overview
XtraPath (https://www.xtrapath.com/) is a cloud-based visual computing, physics simulation, and mathematical animation platform. It bridges abstract STEM formulas with interactive, visual comprehension.

## Organization & Brand
- Brand Name: XtraPath
- Alternate Names: Xtrapath, XtraPath Studio, XtraPath Engine, XtraAnim
- Primary Domain: https://www.xtrapath.com/
- Target Audience: Physics researchers, mathematicians, computer science educators, students, and digital creators.

## Product Suite & Tool Directory

### 1. XtraAnim (Animation & Physics Studio)
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraAnim.html
- Description: Code-to-video creative studio. Allows users to write code and render vector animations, physics simulations, and mathematical graphs in real-time.
- Engines Supported: Python/Manim syntax, Three.js 3D, Rapier physics, HTML5 Canvas 2D, KaTeX equations, Zdog pseudo-3D, JSXGraph.

### 2. XtraBook (Interactive LaTeX STEM Textbooks)
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraBook.html
- Description: Document authoring environment tailored for mathematics, physics, and engineering textbooks. Features auto-LaTeX compilation, dynamic embedded equation widgets, and exportable course structures.

### 3. XtraExplain (Visual Knowledge Explainer)
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraExplain.html
- Description: Visual explanation builder that breaks down complex science laws and algorithms into step-by-step interactive stages.

### 4. Explore (Simulation & Community Hub)
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/explore.html
- Description: Community discovery feed showcasing interactive simulations, chaos pendulums, stick figure kinematics, and mathematical art.

### 5. XtraTools Suite
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/xtraTools.html
- Tools Included:
  - Mermaid Diagram Studio
  - KaTeX LaTeX Formula Editor
  - JSXGraph Dynamic Math Studio
  - Zdog 3D Vector Studio
  - SVG to 3D Extruder
  - TikZ LaTeX Studio
  - Rapier 2D/3D Physics Engine

### 6. Research Lab
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/researchLab.html
- Description: Interactive 2D kinematics and numerical testing sandbox for mechanics, trajectories, and gravity simulations.

### 7. Store
- URL: https://www.xtrapath.com/views/store.html
- Description: Curated collection of 3D simulation models, kinematic rigs, and pedagogical templates.

## Canonical Sitemaps & Feeds
